name: smart-breadcrumb
title: Smart Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb that collapses its middle entries into a disclosure menu once the trail overflows, measured with a ResizeObserver so truncation adapts to the container rather than a fixed item count.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Overflow Collapse: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
